title: Studies into the Storage of Hydrogen in Carbon Nanofibers: Proposal of a Possible Reaction Mechanism
material_description: 90:5:5 as prepared | carbon nanofibers grown on 90:5:5 Fe/Ni/Cu catalyst, as prepared; herringbone CNFs, TEM diameter range 50-280 nm, average 180 nm; carbon yield 22 g/gcat
source_location: main-2 (p. 202), Table 1, row 90:5:5, column 'uptake-as prepared fibers'
notes: Interlayer spacing 0.34 nm from electron diffraction of as-prepared fibers from the 90:5:5 catalyst (Fig. 2 inset, p. 202-203); not XRD. Fig. 3 series: filled triangle (90:5:5 as prepared). Conditions: p printed as 12 MPa (stored 120 bar absolute; Fig. 1 shows an absolute pressure gauge; not called gauge); T from p. 204 'present hydrogen uptake measurements, obtained at 298 K' (p. 202 also says 'ambient temperature'/'room temperature'). Value is the end point of a time-resolved uptake run (Fig. 3, uptake vs time to 300 min; kinetics plot, not digitized); single value for this sample and T, so no isotherm_id. Basis not named; volumetric differential-pressure method (sample vs ballast-matched blank) so basis_inferred = excess by instrumental default. Surface area: Table 1 gives one N2 BET area per catalyst ratio (nitrogen BET at 77 K, p. 202) without saying whether it was measured on the as-prepared or Ar-treated fibers; p. 203 says areas 'only changed by roughly 15%' on Ar treatment; hence area_same_sample = unclear. No BET P/P0 range stated. Degas: printed 'heating under vacuum (ca. 10^3 Pa) at 423 K'; duration not stated. Sample mass printed as 'approximately 50-100 mg' (range, field left empty). Instrument: 'a novel high-pressure apparatus (Figure 1) having four volumetrically balanced chambers', schematic in Fig. 1, authors' own ref. 31; coded as home-built with description. Free volume: ballast matched to sample volume (Fig. 1, D1/S = D2/B) but how the free/sample volume was determined is not stated; blank run without sample and MmNi4.5Al0.5 alloy check (1.27 wt%) reported; calibration_described = false. replicates_reported = true from error bars on this sample's uptake curve in Fig. 3 (magnitude not printed; uncertainty_wt_pct left empty); apparatus 'capable of reproducing hydrogen uptakes as low as 0.1 wt % when using 100 mg' (sensitivity statement, not used as uncertainty). CNFs grown at 873 K from pure ethylene over Fe/Ni/Cu catalyst (Best and Russell procedure), 300 mL/min, 3 h; no purification and no residual-metal content stated, residual catalyst fields left empty. TEM shows nanotubes and amorphous carbon also present.
